ValidationRule.description: Prevents Sales reps from setting an Opportunity directly to "Closed Won"; they must submit it for approval instead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Closed Won"), $Profile.Name <> 'Custom: Fin/Ops/HR', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'ALM - Custom: Fin/Ops/HR', NOT($Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c)) && $Setup.rh2__PS_Settings__c.rh2__Run_Validation_Rule__c
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sales Rep cannot move the Opportunity to Closed Won. Please "Submit for Approval".
